title: Extract workspace split-tree operations into their existing dependency leaf
outcome: Move unchanged recursive WorkspaceNode tree operations and split-ratio constant from workspace.ts to workspace-tree.ts, preserving existing workspace public exports, names, signatures and behavior.
acceptance: Only the existing recursive prune/remove/insert/update tree operations and their existing split-ratio constant move into workspace-tree.ts; no names, parameter lists, behavior or new state owner is introduced.
The new UI module documents ownership/nonownership/source; dependency direction is workspace.ts -> workspace-tree.ts -> type-only workspace-types, with no cycle back to workspace.ts.

Relevant workspace tests, TypeScript and all Vitest pass on the clean candidate, and the independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding; integration follows exact-input green FULL.
